_comment: Claim 11 at the paper's depth: GWS with L = 2 for 50 epochs stores 2,499,264 rows per layer (154 GB in fp32). store_dtype bfloat16 halves this to 77 GB (fits a 96 GB GPU). gws_L2_T10_10ep_bf16 checks bf16 storage against the fp32 10-epoch run (65.05%). Settings as multi_epoch.json (T = 10, eta = 0.003, beta = 10, batch 64, augmentation). Eval batch 64 keeps the logit matrix small. The CIFAR-100 run is gws_L2_T10_50ep_c100_bf16 in multi_epoch_cifar100.json (the dataset is a file-level key).

gws_L2_T10_50ep_bf16.paper_acc: GWS above Adam (~65), SGD and RMSprop, below Muon (~69.5) (Fig. 2 left)
